## Summary

<!--
What changed, in one to three sentences. Add a visual only if it is clearer

-->

## Why

<!-- The problem or limitation that motivated this change. Omit it if the summary makes it obvious. -->

## Evidence

<!--
What you verified: before and after screenshots for UI changes, a test that fails
before and passes after for bug fixes, benchmarks (workload, environment, baseline,
results) for performance changes, or build and test output.
If you didn't run something, write `Not run` and say why.
-->

## Risk and rollback

**Reversibility:** <!-- Reversible | Requires migration | Irreversible -->

**Blast radius:** <!-- Affected components, APIs, persisted data, or users -->
